summary: HDFC Life Insurance received an appeal order confirming a ₹2,422.97 crore GST penalty and tax demand for the period July 2017 to March 2022. The company plans to contest the decision further.

headline: Xelpmoc sells Woovly stake for ₹14.58 crore
summary: Xelpmoc Design and Tech Ltd board approved the sale of its equity investment in Woovly India Private Limited for ₹14.58 crore on September 11, 2026, based on a registered valuer's report.

headline: IIFL Finance accepts resignations of two senior executives
summary: IIFL Finance Ltd has accepted the resignations of Binay Kumar Mishra, Head – Legal, and Vinay Agarwal, Business Head - Loan Against Property. Both departures are effective September 11, 2026.

headline: Ducon Infratechnologies approves rights issue allotment
summary: Ducon Infratechnologies Ltd approved the allotment of 24,99,42,759 equity shares on a 10:13 rights basis at Re. 1.00 per share. The post-issue paid-up capital stands at ₹57,48,68,346.

headline: Jubilant Foodworks pays ₹1.20 dividend
summary: Jubilant Foodworks Ltd has initiated electronic payment of its final dividend of ₹1.20 per share for FY26, as approved by shareholders at the AGM held on August 27, 2026.

headline: Marc Loire Fashions to consider capital hike
summary: Marc Loire Fashions Ltd schedules board meeting on September 16, 2026, to approve increase in authorised share capital and convene an EGM.

headline: BPCL faces ₹48 lakh stamp duty penalty orders
summary: Bharat Petroleum received two stamp duty orders from Gujarat authorities demanding ₹48 lakh in duties and penalties. The company plans to appeal, stating no material financial impact.

headline: RPSG Ventures AGM: Key Resolutions Approved
summary: RPSG Ventures Limited shareholders approved five resolutions at the 9th AGM on September 11, 2026. The agenda included adopting FY26 financials, reappointing directors, and enhancing borrowing limits.

headline: Indiabulls signs deal to acquire 70% in Fintech Cloud
summary: Indiabulls has signed a deal to acquire a 70% stake in Fintech Cloud for ₹1,050 crore through the NCLT process, marking its entry into the fintech sector.
